name: playbook-development-33
title: Monitor cluster utilization metrics
author: harsh.rana@maqsoftware.com
description:
CPU Utilization
Metric: cluster.cpu.utilization_percent

Memory Usage
Metrics:
cluster.memory.used_bytes / cluster.memory.total_bytes
cluster.memory.heap_used_percent (JVM heap for Spark)
cluster.memory.off_heap_used_percent (direct memory)

Disk I/O
Metrics:
cluster.disk.read_throughput_mbps
cluster.disk.write_throughput_mbps
cluster.disk.iops_read, cluster.disk.iops_write
cluster.disk.usage_percent (ephemeral storage)
cluster.disk.io_wait_time_ms (queue depth)

Network I/O
Metrics:
cluster.network.rx_throughput_mbps (receive)
cluster.network.tx_throughput_mbps (transmit)
cluster.network.packet_loss_percent
cluster.network.retransmit_rate

Executor Utilization
Metrics:
spark.executor.active_tasks / spark.executor.max_tasks
spark.executor.idle_time_percent
spark.executor.gc_time_percent (GC overhead)
spark.executor.jvm_memory_used_bytes

Autoscaling Behavior
Metrics:
cluster.autoscale.current_nodes
cluster.autoscale.target_nodes
cluster.autoscale.scale_up_events_count
cluster.autoscale.scale_down_events_count
cluster.autoscale.time_to_scale_seconds

Shuffle Read/Write
Metrics:
spark.shuffle.read_bytes_total
spark.shuffle.write_bytes_total
spark.shuffle.read_time_ms (remote read latency)
spark.shuffle.blocks_fetched_remote
spark.shuffle.fetch_wait_time_ms

Memory & Disk Spill
Metrics:
spark.executor.memory_spill_bytes (spilled to disk)
spark.executor.disk_spill_bytes (read back from disk)
spark.shuffle.spill_memory_bytes
spark.shuffle.spill_disk_bytes
